description: This file defines a set of constants used in the LoRa adapter component of the Eclipse Hono project. It encapsulates string constants representing property names and configuration keys related to LoRa network communication and message handling.

classes.name: LoraConstants
classes.description: A utility class that contains static final string constants used throughout the LoRa adapter implementation for property keys and configuration settings.

methods.name: LoraConstants()
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the utility class.
